author: AutoHit
body:
Hey guys! I've thought of a idea which would help Staff members with reporting, which could lower the chances of two Moderators having the same report.

The idea is that there is a report cycle. Instead of one report going so all Moderators could see, that one report only allows one Moderator to see at a time. Than, when a another Player reports, that report goes to a different Moderator one at a time.

Example:
Player 1: /report (name) (reason)
Moderator 1: Than, the Moderator sees it and goes to deal with it. But, doesn't see Report 2.
Player 2: /report (name) (reason)
Moderator 2: Sees the second report, goes to deal with it. But, doesn't see Report 1.

Than it goes to Moderator 3, Moderator 4, etc. Than, when everyone has gotten at least one report, it goes back to Moderator 1. Like a cycle. Whenever a Staff member joins the game, he/she instantly joins the cycle. This wouldn't effect on forum reports, but would still be helpful.

Thanks for reading c:

replies.author: Mooch24
replies.body:
The problem is some staff members do reports less frequently than the average. So you have some reports that are just completely neglected.

I'd rather see a system where the moderator can type a command /answer or /a for example to answer the particular report number assigned to it. The numbers reset after 50.

ex: Juanpabloxgamer reported GGAllin for "team troller!!!!" (#5)
The staff member can then do /a 5 to be automatically teleported to that player's game and then to the player who was reported.
